d: Turkey… a country where two continents meet, which is the birthplace of Saint Nicholas aka Santa Claus… where the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia, and the hot air balloons flying in the sky… look like magic… where the Turkish Bath, and carpets… are famous all over the world… that country is Turkey… about which there is a lot that you must know… so come with us on a journey to Turkey, on the infinity stream…
